catalog_update.basis: 4.8 inches × 25.4 = 121.92 mm, rounded to 122 mm nominal for sizes 18/20. Size 16 is limited to 26×4.0 (101.6 mm nominal); other wheel/tire pairings remain explicit. Actual casing width varies with tire and rim; 122 mm is not a measured frame gap or universal fit for every size.
